subject: Run and observe ChatGPT-owned Doré Design Build 001
body: OBSERVATION ROLE. ChatGPT owns engineering. Read dore-design/BUILD-LOG.md before interpreting this build. Run the new self-owned Doré Design spine only as a bounded local execution probe. A timeout caused by the resident HTTP server is expected evidence that it stayed alive; do not redesign or replace it. Record what the structured-document -> mutation API -> browser-canvas architecture means for later Doré usage. Mainline engineering decisions remain with ChatGPT.
